opaque_values.rule: Do not replace arbitrary matching strings, substrings, free text, storage keys, URLs, provider parameters or tokens.

typed_item_id.context: Resolve type/kind/sourceType or declared enclosing entity. Untyped selections require exactly one mapped entity; never guess from a colliding old ID.
typed_item_id.citation_source_id: Within typed content citations, source_id/sourceId names the cited content entity, not the crawler data_sources entity.

json_references.external_parameter_exception: Provider-defined external IDs in custom parameters are not platform references solely because their key ends in _id.
json_references.integrity: Preserve object keys, array order, nonreference values and material bodies; map only declared platform references.

generation_tasks.config_snapshot.request.verification: Recompute with the application canonicalizer and compare before commit; do not preserve a stale digest for changed references.

business_ddl_policy.scope: Runtime v5 changes only the 27 declared business audit timestamps to Beijing local timestamp(0) without time zone. Names, nullability, PK/FK, shared sequence and all other types remain compact-v4. Full business DDL is frozen separately in business-v5.json by main.
business_ddl_policy.sql_comparison: Use dialect-aware canonical SQL/structured catalog values; do not lowercase quoted literals or compare SQL by destructive whitespace replacement.
business_ddl_policy.identity: Compare generation mode, sequence options and presence explicitly in the separately frozen business DDL artifact.
business_ddl_policy.indices: Compare uniqueness, ordered keys/expressions, predicates and dialect options, not names alone.
business_ddl_policy.checks: Compare canonical SQL expression semantics from the frozen business DDL artifact.
business_ddl_policy.startup_drift: reject-before-serving-requests; startup validation is read-only and must not create, alter or repair tables
business_ddl_policy.foundation_boundary: RuoYi sys_* models and their DDL are unchanged and not regenerated from business metadata.

audit_timestamp_policy.full_ddl_owner: main; defaults, conversion SQL and physical catalog frozen in business-v5.json
audit_timestamp_policy.verification: Only the declared 27 fields may change. Compare full row projections after explicit Beijing conversion at second precision; protect all non-audit fields, ownership, ACLs, foundation/framework objects and sequence state.
